t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The important factors are the colour pair they come in and the type of forest they take you in. do not concentrate on multiplier or any other factor such as height hat size type e.t.c.

vb_textbox.text: I'll try to keep it simple as possible.Main things to concentrate on - 1) the gnomes come in colour pairs:Blue + PurpleYellow + RedOrange + BrownPink + Green2) Each colour will take you to 1 of 2 forests:Light forestDark forest3) 1x and 5x multiplier will showFind a combination of all 3 factors to find the most mushrooms.Good luckA
